# UI Branding & GitHub Link Quality Checklist: 005-ui-branding-github-link

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for window favicon, header branding, and GitHub link specifications.
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the fallback icon formats explicitly specified if the primary favicon cannot be loaded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are dimensions and scaling ratios specified for the header branding logo? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the repository target URL explicitly documented in requirements rather than assumed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 - Is the positioning of the `GitHub ↗` button in relation to existing header buttons (Undo, Redo, Theme) unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is graceful fallback behavior quantified when running outside the repository root directory? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is browser invocation behavior specified for systems lacking a default desktop URL handler? [Clarity, Edge Case]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 - Do button visual styles for `GitHub ↗` match existing toolbar and header button conventions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are logo asset file paths consistent with repository layout under `assets/img/logo/`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 - Can the startup latency impact (<10ms) be objectively verified without instrumentation conflicts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is browser navigation response time objectively measurable across platforms? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
